definitions.gloss: amiable; sociable; friendly; pleasant in manner
definitions.explanation: Describes someone who is warm, approachable, and pleasant in their interactions with others. The person smiles easily, greets people cheerfully, and makes others feel welcome.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{店員|てんいん}→店員：00897_tenin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{愛想|あいそ}がいい。
examples.english: That shop clerk is very friendly.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{誰|だれ}→誰：00534_dare⟧⟦に{対|たい}して→に対して：06800_nitaishite⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{愛想|あいそ}がいい⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: She is popular because she is friendly to everyone.

examples.japanese: {愛想|あいそ}がいい⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{信頼|しんらい}→信頼：03268_shinrai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{得|え}られない→得る：02014_eru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{第一印象|だいいちいんしょう}→第一印象：19299_daiichiinshou⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧だ。
examples.english: Being pleasant alone won't earn trust, but it is very important as a first impression.

notes:
USAGE:
The opposite expression is ⟦{愛想|あいそ}が{悪|わる}い→愛想が悪い：22686_aisogawarui⟧ (unfriendly, cold). Can also be written {愛想|あいそう}がいい with the longer reading. In some contexts, being excessively {愛想|あいそ}がいい can imply insincerity.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {愛想|あいそ}がいい⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧ (a friendly person)
- ⟦{愛想|あいそ}→愛想：12699_aiso⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{振|ふ}る{舞|ま}う→振る舞う：04233_furumau⟧ (to behave in a friendly manner)
- ⟦{愛想|あいそ}が{悪|わる}い→愛想が悪い：22686_aisogawarui⟧ (unfriendly, unsociable)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{人懐|ひとなつ}っこい→人懐っこい：10912_hitonatsukkoi⟧: friendly and easy to get along with — emphasizes warmth and approachability
- ⟦{社交的|しゃこうてき}→社交的：08457_shakouteki⟧: sociable — describes an outgoing personality in general
